NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S)
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. 4.1 ADOPT RESOLUTION NOS. CC 2013-047, SA 2013-012, PCA 2013-001, HA 2013-001, IDA 2013-001, PAA 2013-001, and PFA 2013-001, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, AND THE PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE CITY OF PALMDALE'S BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2013-14 AND APPROVING REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE ADJUSTMENTS TO FISCAL YEAR 2012-13. Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
Staff Recommendation: Move to close Public Hearing. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to close.) Move to adopt Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2013-047, SA 2013-012, PCA 2013-001, HA 2013-001, IDA 2013-001, PAA 2013-001, and PFA 2013-001. (Voice Vote - Requires a Majority to Adopt) ___________ OR ___________
4.2 ADOPT RESOLUTION NOS. CC 2013-054, SA 2013-013, PCA 2013-002, HA 2013-003, IDA 2013-002, PAA 2013-002, and PFA 2013-002, A JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, THE PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, AND THE PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY AUTHORIZING THE CONTINUATION OF SPENDING FOR THE 2013-14 FISCAL YEAR AT THE PRESENT LEVEL. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
Staff Recommendation: Move to adopt Joint Resolution Nos. CC 2013-054, SA 2013-013, PCA 2013-002, HA 2013-003, IDA 2013-002, PAA 2013-002, and PFA 2013-002. (Voice Vote - Requires a Majority to Adopt)
5. HA CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
6. CONSENT CALENDAR:
6.1 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AN OWNER PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND PAVING THE WAY FOUNDATION AND AUTHORIZING ITS IMPLEMENTATION. (Staff Reference: Economic Development Manager Walter)
6.2 Approve the minutes from the previous meeting held May 1, 2013 (7:00 pm). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT:
